description_en: Gaṇeśa Mandira is located in Kotā Ṭola, Bungmati. The Tulādhara and Mālī caste groups worship this Gaṇeśa as their local deity. Themandirafaces south and has ajhĩgaṭītiled roof supported by carved struts. A metal pinnacle and parasol can be found atop the roof. Atoraṇahas been placed above the carved wooden door. The main façade is decorated with latticed woodwork and two small latticed windows have been installed in the eastern and western walls of the temple.An aniconic stone image of Gaṇeśa with a metal crown on his head is enshrined in the sanctum. Besides the main shrine, many iconic and aniconic stone images can be seen around the sanctum. A woodentoraṇais attached to the eastern wall. There was ahiti(stepwell) to the east of the temple until a few decades ago. However, it gradually turned into a rubbish dumping site and was eventually covered up with mud. Before thehitiwas completely filled in, some of the statues were removed and relocated to this temple and the nearby Licchavicaitya(BUN0026).The temple was reconstructed in 2003. The projecting roof on the northern side was left unfinished during the reconstruction process, meaning that the temple's structure appears unbalanced. Local residents traditionally come to this temple to worship Gaṇeśa before they begin any other auspicious rituals such as initiation ceremonies, marriage orjaṃko(Skt.bhīmarathārohaṇa). The Kusle (Kapālī) community were responsible for taking care of thistemple until a few years ago. However, now that this community no longer takes care of this temple there are no official caretakers (dyaḥpāḥlāḥs).
description_ne: यो मन्दिर बुंगमतीको कोता टोलमा रहेका तुलाधर र माली समुदायको थान गणेश हो । एक तह छाना भएको यस मन्दिरको छानामा झिंगटी राखिएको छ । छानामाथि कलशाकारको धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । गजूरमाथि छत्र चढाइएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि काष्ठ तोरण राखिएको छ । चार हात भएको गणेश दुई मुसामाथि चढेका छन् । यो तोरण विसं २०३३ मा चढाइएको थियो । गर्भगृहभित्र आकृतिविहीन ढुंगालाई गणेशको रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गणेश मानिने ढुंगाको शिरोभागमा धातुको मुकुट चढाइएको छ । गणेशको दायाँ-बायाँ उमामहेश्वर, धातुको गणेश, शिवलिंग लगायत केही आकृतिविहीन ढुंगाहरू राखिएका छन् । यो गणेश मन्दिरको पूर्वतिर रहेको खाली ठाउँमा पहिले ढुंगेधारा रहेको थियो । पानी आउन बन्द भएपछि फोहर फाल्ने ठाउँको रूपमा परिणत भएपछि स्थानीयहरूले उक्त ढुंगेधारा पुरिदिएका थिए । ढुंगेधारामा रहेका मूर्तिहरूमध्ये केहीलाई सँगै रहेको लिच्छवि चैत्य(BUN0026)राखिएको थियो भने केहीलाई यस गणेश मन्दिरमा राखिएको थियो । गणेशमाथि जीर्ण भइसकेको पुरानो तोरण राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको उत्तरपट्टिको गारोमा ढुंगाबाट बनेको चामरको एक जोडा बनाइएको छ ।यो मन्दिरको स्थापनाबारे कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त भएको छैन । स्थानीयहरूका अनुसार रातो मच्छिन्द्रनाथलाई बुंगमतीमा ल्याउनुभन्दा अघि नै यो मन्दिरको निर्माण भइसकेको थियो । विसं २०६० सालमा यस मन्दिरको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । कोता टोलमा कसैको व्रतबन्ध, विवाह वा भीमरथारोहण जस्ता शुभकार्य गर्नुपर्दा सबभन्दा पहिले यसै मन्दिरमा आएर पूजा गर्नुपर्ने परम्परा छ । यो मन्दिरमा कुनै पूजारी नियुक्त गरी नियमित पूजा गर्ने व्यवस्था गरिएको छैन । पहिले कुस्ले (कपाली) हरूले द्य:पा:ला:को जिम्मेवारी वहन गर्थे । उनीहरूले मन्दिरको सरसफाइ गर्ने लगायत मन्दिरमा चढाइने भेटी लिने गर्थे । अहिले आएर कुस्लेहरूले द्य:पा:ला:को काम गर्न छाडेका छन् ।

historical_events.event_name: Pavement of the courtyard and donation of ornaments
historical_events.event_description: Harṣajyoti and his wife Bhima Thakũ offered an ornament to Gaṇeśa and Rāto Matsyendranātha and paved the courtyard of this temple with stones.
Thetoraṇafixed above the main door was donated. The name of the donor could not be identified.
Puṇyarāja Tulādhara, Sānumāyā Tulādhara and their family members made an offering of a brass plate engraved with the symbols foraṣṭamaṅgala.

Local residents reconstructed the temple with the help of Bungmati Sāṃskṛtika Adhyayana Kendra, a research center focusing on the cultural history of Bungamti. The reconstruction work started in the 27th of Caitra (VS 2059) and was completed in the 20th of Jyeṣṭha (VS 2060). It was officially inaugurated on the 23rd of Śrāvaṇa (VS 2060).
